description: One prompt whose first candidate/target divergence recurred at generated token 68 in every fixed-scratch validation arm.

prompts.prompt: Review a service design where multiple workers read a job row, call an external API, then mark the row complete. Describe a concrete PostgreSQL transaction pattern that prevents duplicate work, how retries and idempotency keys interact, and what failures still need monitoring. Include SQL or pseudocode and an actionable test plan.
